regions.region: left column: title, abstract-style introduction, author and SI note
regions.finding: The paper introduces a Pd-catalyzed coupling/cyclization of 2,3-allenoic acids with methyl propiolate. Earlier allene dimerization and carbometalation work is cited literature, not imported as experiments. The page states that SI exists online, but no SI file was supplied and no association was inferred.

regions.region: upper-right reaction drawing and Table 1 header/structures
regions.finding: The common Table 1 reaction is 1a plus methyl propiolate 2 under Pd catalyst/additive in CCl3Me at 35-40 °C, with depicted products 3a, 4a, 5a, 7a and bracketed normal 1:2 adduct 6a. Product labels and raster evidence are retained; complex product SMILES remain unresolved.

Eight independent optimization rows were extracted. Entry-specific methyl-propiolate equivalents, additives/loadings, times, four product-yield columns, NMR basis, recovered starting material in rows 1 and 5, the PdCl2 override in row 5, and the combined Sc(OTf)3/BF3·Et2O footnote in row 8 were preserved. Table dashes were not converted to zero.
The prose confirms selected yields and outcomes for entries 1-7 and identifies 5a as a migration product of 6a. These statements support the corresponding table records and do not create duplicates.

unresolved: The source advertises Supporting Information, but it was not supplied or explicitly associated.
Atmosphere, row-specific charge amounts, and workup/isolation details are absent for most Table 1 rows.
A Table 1 dash is preserved as a literal unquantified table result rather than interpreted as zero or not detected.

regions.region: upper-left prose completing Table 1 entry 7 and describing entry 8
regions.finding: The optimized syringe-pump experiment producing 5a in 71% NMR yield and 5a/4a = 16:1 is the same experiment represented by Table 1 entry 8, Table 2 entry 1, and the page 3 typical procedure; it was merged into one record.

Two distinct experiments, substrates 1i (R=Me) and 1j (R=Et), were extracted with separate 4/6 yields and isolated yields. The prose-only less-than-5% migration adduct result for the ethyl case is preserved as an upper bound.

regions.region: lower-left Table 2 rows 1-8 and footnotes a-d
regions.finding: All eight substrate-scope rows were read. Row 1 was deduplicated into the optimized 1a record; rows 2-8 are independent records. Shared scale, equivalents, catalyst/additive loadings, solvent volume, 4/5 ratios, NMR yields, isolated yields, row 3 approximate 7c yield, and row 7's 7 equivalents of 2 were structured.

regions.region: middle-right prose: low-temperature trapping and 6a-to-5a conversion
regions.finding: The 12 °C, 5 h experiment isolating a 5a/6a mixture and the subsequent catalyst-free conversion of 6a to 5a in CDCl3 at 25 °C were treated as separate experimental stages/records.

regions.region: middle-right prose: deuterium studies and 1k result
regions.finding: Narrative assignments and deuterium incorporation for [D1]1a and [D2]1a, plus the 8% residual 6k after 69 h, were linked to Schemes 2-4 on page 3 rather than duplicated.
The text proposes intermediates 8-11 and double antarafacial 1,7-hydrogen migration. It is classified as a plausible mechanism, not a reported experiment.

unresolved: Table 2 omits reaction times and row-specific procedures.
Scheme 1 omits additive loadings, methyl-propiolate equivalents, time, atmosphere, and workup.
Exact conditions and yields for the 12 °C trapping experiment are incomplete in the main text.
The SI was not supplied or explicitly associated.

regions.finding: The catalyst-free 6a-to-5a conversion in CDCl3 at 25 °C is monitored by 1H NMR immediately after isolation, after 6 h, and after 27 h; ratios 1.27:1.00, 0.25:1.00, and 0.02:1.00 were captured in one time-course record.

Two independent deuterium-labeling experiments were extracted with displayed methyl-propiolate equivalents, solvent or solvent ratio, temperatures, times, product yields, deuterium incorporation bounds/approximations, and positional-assignment notes.
The 1k experiment with 6 equivalents of 2 at 35 °C for 69 h was extracted with NMR yields of 4k (3%), 5k (72%), and 6k (8%).
The plausible catalytic cycle, intermediates 8-11, protonolysis paths, and double 1,7-hydrogen shifts were retained in a mechanism record and were not assigned experimental yields.

regions.region: lower-right Experimental Section and characterization start
regions.finding: The detailed 1a/2 procedure was merged with Table 1 entry 8 and Table 2 entry 1. It supplies feed and receiving-flask charges, syringe-pump rate, 40 °C stages, post-addition 13 h, TLC completion, filtration, NMR internal standard, 5a NMR/isolated results, chromatography, and initial 4a characterization.

unresolved: Schemes 2-4 omit some catalyst/additive quantities, atmosphere, workup, and isolation details.
The displayed isotope positions were retained by labels and prose; isotopologue SMILES were not asserted.
Table 1's 12 h, Table 2's 35 °C, and the detailed procedure's pump addition plus 13 h at 40 °C are source-level differences requiring review.
The syringe-pump rate is preserved as operation text because compound rate units are not supported by the schema.

regions.finding: This page continues the same optimized 1a experiment with 4a MS/IR/elemental analysis and 5a NMR/MS/IR/HRMS characterization. It supports the existing optimized record and is not counted as a new reaction.

regions.region: remaining page: dates, keywords, and references 1-11
regions.finding: No new experiment is reported. The remainder is publication metadata and cited literature; cited reactions and mechanistic precedents were not imported as this paper's experiments.

unresolved: The page supplies characterization, not missing SI procedures.
No independent structure verification was performed from spectra alone; complex product SMILES remain unset.
